faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur Project Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the IIT Kharagpur Project Engineer positions is 07 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Project Engineer role, candidates must possess a M.Tech. / M.E. (or equivalent) in Engineering, or a B.Tech. / B.E. degree with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Engineer post is 45 years. However, age relaxation may be provided based on sponsor agency rules, if applicable.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Engineer position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56100 Per Month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Project Engineer in this recruitment drive by IIT Kharagpur.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for positions in Gujarat, specifically in Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of IIT Kharagpur or via the direct application link provided in the 'Important Links' section before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this IIT Kharagpur Project Engineer recruitment is IIT/Gn/R/SPL/2026/09.
